# Soner Altın

> Soner Altın is a software engineer who makes iPhone apps. He has two dogs and likes running.

Owner: Soner Altın, Software Engineer.
Contact: hello@soneraltin.com

The site is in English. Baseline - Sleep Debt reads Apple Health on iPhone and is not a medical device. Easytv Play is only a media player for the user’s own M3U or Xtream playlist. It does not provide channels, subscriptions, or content.

## Home

- [Home](https://soneraltin.com/): Soner Altın, a software engineer who makes iPhone apps. He has two dogs and likes running.

## Apps

- [Apps](https://soneraltin.com/apps/): The two iPhone apps, Baseline - Sleep Debt and Easytv Play, with a short description of each.
- [Baseline - Sleep Debt](https://soneraltin.com/apps/baseline/): iPhone sleep debt app that reads Apple Health and explains the numbers on device with Apple Intelligence. Not a medical device.
- [Easytv Play](https://soneraltin.com/apps/easytv/): iPhone media player for the user’s own M3U or Xtream playlist. It does not provide channels, subscriptions, or content, and it has no third-party tracking.

## Privacy

- [Baseline privacy policy](https://soneraltin.com/apps/baseline/privacy/): How Baseline handles Apple Health, on-device Apple Intelligence summaries, and the account.
- [Easytv Play privacy policy](https://soneraltin.com/apps/easytv/privacy/): How Easytv Play handles an optional account, playlist login, favorites, and watch history. The app hosts no content.
